method: spec-vs-code audit of each RFC against main (d0a0314 + merged #28/#34/#35); every item carries file evidence from the audited tree

rfc-0001.title: Open institutional custody (core)

gaps.summary: Asset, ChainWallet, and Vault reach the signer inside SigningMaterials with no admin signature and no envelope hash commitment; only the destination is hash-bound (destination_hash). A compromised coordinator can supply a forged but internally consistent set and obtain a signature under another vault's rule; zero-approval rules make this concrete. KeyDescriptor is described as signed in §7.3 but has no signature field.
gaps.fix_shape: Extend the envelope to commit hashes of asset, wallet, vault, and key descriptor the way destination_hash does. Protocol change: envelope schema and golden vectors; needs a deliberate compatibility decision, not a quick patch.
gaps.test_gap: A03 test mutates the wallet without rebuilding the envelope; add a consistently-forged-set test.

gaps.summary: No destination supersession: an older admin-signed destination version stays signable forever. The kernel only checks the version equals what the proposer wrote in the intent; the only revocation is denying the whole destination id.
gaps.fix_shape: Enforce latest-enrolled-version at intent build/create (fail closed on superseded versions); longer term, an ordered destination registry in the authority.
gaps.fixed_in: this commit, REDUCED not closed: the API build path now refuses a destination version older than the newest enrolled version for that id. That catches honest proposer mistakes only. The audited threat — a compromised coordinator that talks to the signer directly, skipping the API — is unchanged: the signer still accepts any admin-signed version. The signer-checked destination registry is a protocol change and remains open.

gaps.summary: Most public API resources absent: no /v1/vaults, wallets enrollment, destination/policy/configuration proposals, freeze, or recovery-ceremony routes. Freeze exists only as a library call; no SDK directory; CLI has only demo and display-inputs.
EVM has no threshold backend (dev single-key signer; cggmp24 not integrated). FROST declares supports_refresh=false and supports_recover_or_replace=false.
gaps.note: Share refresh is a reserved design decision (RFC-0002 §3 decision 1); blocks A33.

gaps.summary: Admin changes have no delay, no before/after diff object, and widening vs narrowing a policy is treated the same. TrustRoots (verifier builds, chain profiles) are static per-signer settings, not ordered admin-quorum transactions.

No replacement or cancellation workflow after dispatch: candidate_revision hardcoded to 1, cancel returns IssuanceUncertain without invalidation, broadcaster refuses a second candidate, no gas-bump/same-nonce-cancel builder. Authority supports ReplacementPending.
One-time-state rollback fencing is local only: production callers open the ledger without an external high-water mark, so a whole-disk snapshot restore rolls back the sidecar too.

EVM verification thinner than spec: chain-id-only network identity (no genesis binding), fixed 65000 gas limit with no simulation, no L2 fee component, finality is a fixed confirmation count defaulting to 1 where the spec forbids fixed counts, no EIP-7702 delegation or allowance inventory.
Solana delegate/close-authority checks run only on the destination token account; an existing source delegate is not detected; mint owner program taken from the registry, not evidence.

Evidence trust weakly enforced: trust_level is declared by untrusted callers, the bundle is unsigned, SingleProvider is blocked only when environment_id is literally 'mainnet', and pre-sign evidence is never cross-checked across sources.
API scopes limited to Read/Propose/Approve/Submit; spec also requires administrator, broadcaster, auditor, recovery roles. Webhooks are pull-only; WebhookSubscription type is unused.
PolicyRule has no vault-tier dimension; fees have only a per-operation maximum (no rolling native-fee budget applied).
No TEE/HSM; shares sealed in software; development DKG runs on one machine. Gate D hardware scope.
No Bitcoin/Cosmos/Sui/Aptos/XRPL adapters; only NativeResource placeholder variants. Gate E scope; blocks A25-A29.

rfc-0001.covered: §3.2-§3.4, §5.1-§5.4, I1/I4/I5/I7 signer checks, §8 adapter contract, §10.1-10.2/10.4-10.5, §12.1-12.2, §13.2, §13.3 idempotency and error codes, §4.3 credential distinctness.

gates.C: done except true multi-machine qualification (needs a second physical host)
gates.D: external: audit booking (docs/audit-readiness.md), HSM hardware, independent operators, pilot approval
gates.E: not started (one requested capability at a time)

rfc-0003.title: Institution-operated signer network
known_fences_confirmed: A33 residual threshold power documented with a test
readmission is a development-only fleet-restart ceremony
roster propagation pending (SingleEpoch blocks committee activation)
BETA cfg gate in CI (lib only; node-runner binary uncovered, no N26 negative test)

gaps.summary: Attestation flow is a library with no network wiring: no VerificationRequest in peer-wire, nothing uses channel 11, no verifier node runtime, required_attestations policy absent, verifier-disagreement quarantine in memory only.

Networked lifecycle cannot pass ISSUANCE_COMMITTED: AuthorityRequest lacks RegisterIntent and Observe; intent registration requires a process on the authority host; SignatureObserved is local to the coordinator; D2 refuses RecordObservation.
D2 has no gateway submission path (Proposer::submit is replica-local; NodeApi 403s without a replica proposer) and no OpenFinalized/ReleaseFinalized coordinator driver.
D2 equivocation evidence (ConflictingNotarize/ConflictingFinalize/NullifyFinalize) is never kept or exported; ExportBundle covers D1 only; no N15 test.

Nothing publishes authority checkpoints to witnesses (consumer exists, no producer); node-runner opens the store without witness rollback detection; D1 reference topology has no witness node though §12 requires one.

All channels share one 128-entry inbound queue and one event queue; one flooding admitted peer starves Hello (5s convergence TTL) and authority.rpc replies, causing refused sessions and IssuanceUnknown.
No metrics or logs from network crates; inbound and event drops silently discarded; handshake failures, roster divergence, session aborts, attestation disagreements, nullifications not exposed.
Coordinator crash recovery: no reconciliation of in-flight operations on restart; approval expiry unreachable over authority.rpc, so a crash before Release strands reserved exposure.
Node API has 2 of ~11 spec'd endpoints (log, approvals); halt only via local IPC; no content-addressed gateway store; materials travel inline in SessionControl.
signer-core never measures its own build (checks only claimed hashes); Hello lacks the generation and build_hash fields.
Per-node journal incomplete: session rejection reasons, peer blocks, attestations not journaled; gateway/authority-rpc/transport keep no signed journal.
Class C data (intents, candidates, grants) plaintext at rest in journals and stores; disclosed in docs.
No networked DKG (CeremonyOpen/CeremonyResult absent); DKG is offline fixture provisioning; no point-to-point payload encryption to signer-core keys. Disclosed.
Halt key is a free-standing operator key, unbound to roster administrators; minimum_halt_sequence hardcoded 0 (no rollback floor); unhalt only in the local journal.
Passkey sign_count parsed but never compared (no clone alert); no AAGUID allowlist.
gaps.fix_shape: Clone detection needs a persisted monotonic counter per enrolled credential. ApproverCredential is an admin-signed stored object, so adding last_sign_count is a schema and enrollment-flow change, not a patch.

rfc-0003.covered: §3.2-§3.3 roster validation, §4.1-§4.2 ACLs, §6.3 D2 re-execution, §8.1 Class S fences, §8.3 signed MPC frames, §10 generation fencing, §15 WebAuthn verification and proposer-exclusion, Stateright model.

rfc-0004.title: Operator console

gaps.summary: No authentication, RBAC, or scoping: boundary.ts gives CSRF-style protection only; one server-held bearer for every caller; Administration always visible.

Admin/governance screens are placeholder requirement tables; mutation button permanently disabled; no policy draft/simulation/diff, admin quorum, verifier handoff, offboarding, freeze/halt, recovery drill, credentials or webhooks.
No operations workflows (fee funding, sweeps, paused states) and no receive/deposit panel (no address or QR).
Case detail exists for sample fixtures only; real records get an inline alert; no case object, owner, RPC-disagreement/reorg handling, or identical-bytes rebroadcast.

Every non-OK mutation response, including definitive 4xx policy rejections, is flattened to a generic outcome-unknown message, dropping the backend reason; only a raw last_error code badge is shown; required_approvals parsed but never rendered.
gaps.fixed_in: this commit, partially: the bridge reflects only the backend's error CODE with a console-authored per-code explanation; backend detail text is never reflected (it can carry sensitive diagnostics). Only the create route is definitive (outcome_unknown=false): no signing can have happened for an intent whose create returned 4xx. Submit, cancel, and refresh errors always keep outcome_unknown=true with the inspect-first instruction, because codes like NOT_FOUND or STALE_EVIDENCE can arrive after a signature exists. ISSUANCE_UNCERTAIN, unknown codes, 5xx, redirects, and unreadable bodies keep the fail-safe unknown-outcome message. Rendering required_approvals remains open.

gaps.summary: Approval inbox filters on dispatch=ready without expiry/eligibility checks; no verifier deep link (CLI accepted per Q2); correctly no Approve button.
Raw state names; only FINALIZED_SUCCESS green, failures amber instead of red; no per-state labels/safe actions; no real-record operation timeline. Uncertain states correctly block retry/cancel.

Setup preflight hard-codes complete:true (spec forbids misleading success); release_signature_verified literal false; test-transfer step hard-coded awaiting; stale blocker still listed; no vault seeding or deposit step; checklist is a page, not persistent.
Migration is CSV watch-only import only (works well); no manifest, semantic-gap report, canary, batch approval, or reconciliation.
No event search/filtering or sequence-gap detection in local mode; no global search; export limited to custody export plus first 1000 events.
Generic stale banner only; no per-scope age thresholds; balances shown without freshness check.

rfc-0004.covered: Navigation matches §5; bridge/demo/watch-only boundaries (§3, §10) enforced: loopback-only upstream, route allowlist, idempotency key, body cap, demo write-block, watch-only never enrolls authority.
